fullPassage: All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time fast forwarding or rewinding videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like using a word processing program. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.

❌ ① digital: digital(디지털의)은 nonlinear와 대조 개념이 아님
✅ ② sequential: sequential(순차적인)은 임의 접근이 아닌 순서대로 진행하는 방식으로, nonlinear(비선형의)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ③ random: random(임의의)은 오히려 nonlinear 시스템의 특성과 유사
❌ ④ automatic: automatic(자동의)은 nonlinear와 반대 개념이 아님
det.tip: nonlinear(비선형의) ↔ sequential/linear(순차적인/선형의)

questions.passage:
(A) Before the meeting started, they <u>fixed</u> the shelf firmly to the wall so that it would not fall.
(B) If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and <u>fixed</u> with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 fix의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fix: (A) 선반을 벽에 고정하다 / (B) 실수를 바로잡다/수정하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 정하다 — (B) 수리하다/바로잡다: (A)의 fix는 날짜를 정하는 것이 아닌 선반을 고정
❌ ② (A) 고정하다 — (B) 정하다: (B)는 실수를 수정하는 '바로잡다'로 '정하다'가 부적절
❌ ③ (A) 수리하다/바로잡다 — (B) 고정하다: (A)는 선반을 고정하는 것으로 '수리하다'가 부적절
✅ ④ (A) 고정하다 — (B) 수리하다/바로잡다: (A)는 선반을 벽에 '고정하다', (B)는 실수를 '바로잡다/수정하다'로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
det.tip: fix: ① 수리하다/바로잡다 ② 고정하다 ③ (날짜 등을) 정하다 ④ 준비하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "able to be reached or obtained freely in any order"

det.korean: random (access)=임의의/무작위의 — 어떤 순서로든 자유롭게 접근할 수 있는
det.analysis:
✅ ① random: random(임의의)은 어떤 순서로든 자유롭게 접근할 수 있다는 영영 정의에 일치 ←정답
❌ ② linear: linear(선형의)는 순서대로 진행하는 방식으로 임의 접근과 반대
❌ ③ visible: visible(눈에 보이는)은 접근 순서와 무관한 시각적 개념
❌ ④ manual: manual(수동의)은 접근 방식이 아닌 조작 방법을 뜻함
det.tip: random access = 임의 접근. in any order가 핵심

questions.passage: Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like __________ (use) a word processing program. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 전치사 like 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(V-ing)가 와야 한다. is like + V-ing 구문. use → using
det.tip: like + V-ing (동명사) — 전치사 뒤에는 동명사가 온다

questions.passage: If a mistake was made or new information needed to be __________ (add) the whole piece had to be retyped. Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like using a word processing program.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: to be 뒤에 과거분사(p.p.) — 수동태 to부정사
det.analysis: new information needed to be ~에서 'to be + 과거분사'는 수동태 to부정사 형태이다. 정보가 '추가되는' 수동 의미이므로 add → added. needed to be added(추가되어야 했다)
det.tip: to be + p.p. (수동태 to부정사): needed to be added(추가되어야 하다)

questions.passage: All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time fast forwarding or rewinding videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. Nonlinear editing, __________, is like using a word processing program. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: on the other hand=반면에 — 선형 편집과 비선형 편집을 대조
det.analysis:
❌ ① as a result: as a result(결과적으로)는 인과 관계로, 두 편집 방식의 대조와 맞지 않음
❌ ② for example: for example(예를 들어)은 예시 제시로 대조 관계가 아님
✅ ③ on the other hand: 원문 일치. 선형 편집(타자기)과 달리 비선형 편집은 워드 프로세서 같다는 대조 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ in addition: in addition(게다가)은 부가 관계로 대조와 다름
det.tip: Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like ~ — 반면, 비선형 편집은 ~

questions.passage: All editing systems are now nonlinear computer-based systems that allow random access to any video shot or scene without having to __________ to find it. Nonlinear systems can create a range of special effects, such as slow motion, wipes and dissolves. Another highlight of a digital nonlinear system is its random access process that makes it easy for an editor to find desired shots or scenes without having to spend time fast forwarding or rewinding videotape. With nonlinear editing, shots or scenes can be easily added or removed anywhere in the program, and the computer adjusts the program length automatically. Linear editing was like composing a paper on a typewriter. If a mistake was made or new information needed to be added the whole piece had to be retyped. Nonlinear editing, on the other hand, is like using a word processing program. If a mistake is made, it is easily deleted and fixed with a few keystrokes, and new information can be added easily.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fast forward or fast reverse=빨리 감기나 빨리 되감기 — 이것 없이도 어떤 장면에 접근 가능
det.analysis:
❌ ① pause the playback: pause the playback(재생을 멈추다)은 임의 접근의 핵심인 '빨리 감기 불필요' 맥락과 다름
✅ ② fast forward or fast reverse: 원문 일치. 어떤 장면을 찾기 위해 빨리 감기나 빨리 되감기(fast forward or fast reverse)를 할 필요 없이 임의 접근한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ adjust the volume: adjust the volume(음량을 조절하다)은 장면 접근과 무관
❌ ④ delete the clip: delete the clip(클립을 삭제하다)은 접근 방식 설명과 상충
det.tip: without having to fast forward or fast reverse to find it — 빨리 감기/되감기 없이
